subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter — evidence delivery options
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Compliance Team <compliance@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter — evidence delivery options

Hi Megan / Acme Compliance team,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Per our procurement and security review we need a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a brief bridge letter outlining any changes since the report period. To keep the intake low-friction, please provide the following if available: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the Security principle (preferred) — include the audit period dates in the file name.
- Bridge letter (PDF or docx) summarizing any material changes since the report period and whether the controls are still representative.
- A short manifest (CSV) mapping filenames to control areas (example attached: evidence_inventory_template.csv).
- If you are comfortable, 1–2 representative artefacts or log samples (redacted) showing evidence of change control, incident response, or privileged access reviews.

Delivery options we accept: presigned S3 links, secure Google Drive folder with view-only links, or SFTP. If you prefer a portal upload, we can provide credentials. We are happy to sign an NDA prior to receiving any sensitive attachments.

To keep routing simple, please do not include full PII in shared samples; redacted examples are fine. For filename convention we recommend: VendorName_SOC2_TypeII_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf and BridgeLetter_VendorName_YYYY-MM-DD.docx.

If helpful, I attached a short bridge-letter sample and an evidence inventory template you can use. Also below are two one-line reply templates you can use to accelerate the handoff.

One-line reply (report only):
"Hi Irene — attached is our SOC 2 Type II report (Security) for period 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. We can provide additional artefacts on request. — Megan"

One-line reply (report + presigned link):
"Hi Irene — report attached and evidence samples are available at <presigned link>. Please confirm receipt. — Megan"

Please let us know if Acme needs an NDA or if you want a short call to review transfer options. Target timeline: if possible, we'd appreciate materials by EOD 2027-04-12 to align with our procurement window.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: bridge_letter_sample.docx, evidence_inventory_template.csv

From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acmecorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter — evidence delivery options

Hi Irene,

Thanks — we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for the Security principle and a short bridge letter. Quick clarifying questions so we deliver exactly what you need: 

1) Audit period: you mentioned EOD 2027-04-12 for delivery. Do you need the report to specifically cover 2026-04-01 → 2027-03-31, or are broader periods acceptable? Our most recent report covers that exact window.
2) Evidence samples: what level of redaction is acceptable? We typically remove usernames and IPs, leaving timestamps and event types.
3) Metadata: do you need a CSV manifest with control mappings and owners, or is a simple file list sufficient?

We prefer to share via an SFTP drop. We can also provide a presigned S3 link (48h expiry) if that is simpler. NDA — our legal team prefers to avoid executing separate NDAs for standard assurance docs, but we can provide a one-way confidentiality notice inside the transfer if required.

If that works, we'll send the report PDF and bridge letter and include an evidence_manifest.csv with suggested filenames. Expect the first package tomorrow (2027-04-06) via SFTP; I'll follow up with credentials.

Best,
Megan Liu
Head of Compliance (Acme Cloud)
megan.liu@acmecorp.com | +1 212-555-9988

On Sun, Apr 4, 2027 at 09:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original request]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Compliance Team <compliance@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter — evidence delivery options

Perfect — thanks Megan. Answers inline: 

1) Audit period: the exact window 2026-04-01 → 2027-03-31 is ideal (that matches our expected coverage). If your report uses slightly different dates, please call that out in the manifest.
2) Redaction guidance: timestamps and event types are very helpful. Please redact usernames, email addresses, and full IPs (partial IPs like 10.x.x.x or 192.0.2.x are fine). Remove any customer-identifying PII.
3) Manifest: a CSV with filename, control mapping (by trust service criterion), and owner name is preferred — the attached evidence_inventory_template.csv is fine. 

Delivery: SFTP is fine. If you send a presigned S3 link, please grant us read access for at least 72 hours. For the presigned option, we can accept a 48–72 hour window.

NDA: no separate NDA required — a short confidentiality header in the transfer is sufficient. We'll treat the files as confidential in our intake system.

Next steps for Acme (copy the one-liners if helpful):

- Report only (email attach): "Hi Irene — attached is Acme SOC 2 Type II (Security) for 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. Manifest attached. — Megan"

- SFTP + manifest: "Hi Irene — report attached; evidence samples uploaded to SFTP at sftp.acmecorp.com/path (credentials below). Manifest attached. — Megan"

If you upload a couple of short log samples, please add a short README in the SFTP folder describing what each sample is (e.g., control ID, date range, redaction notes).

I'll loop in Marissa for procurement sign-off once we have the package. Thanks again — looking forward to the files.

Regards,
Irene
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (sent in thread): evidence_inventory_template.csv, bridge_letter_sample.docx
